//: Root Directory stays at the repository root. The frontend build reads
docs/framework through scripts/sync-docs.mjs, which lives above frontend/;
with the root set to frontend/ the prebuild step cannot see it and the
deploy fails. Keeping the commands here rather than in the dashboard means
the reason this works is reviewable in a diff.
framework is null on purpose. next.config.mjs sets output: 'export', so
the build emits a plain static site and there is no server runtime for the
Next.js builder to manage. Declaring nextjs here while pointing
outputDirectory at out/ asks Vercel for two contradictory things.
